vocabulary.meaning: connected with a celebration or holiday
examples: The streets looked festive with lights and decorations.
Everyone was in a festive mood.

vocabulary.meaning: an enjoyable event marking a special occasion
examples: The family held a large celebration.
Food is often central to seasonal celebrations.

vocabulary.meaning: a custom passed from one generation to another
examples: The family follows several holiday traditions.
Traditions can change over time.
The holiday gathering included relatives from several cities.
Large gatherings can be joyful and exhausting.

vocabulary.meaning: an object used to make a place look attractive for a celebration
examples: Children made their own decorations.
The office was full of seasonal decorations.

vocabulary.meaning: connected with a particular time of year
examples: Shops sell many seasonal products in December.
The restaurant introduced a seasonal menu.
The family prepared a feast for the holiday.
Traditional feasts often take hours to cook.
The music created a cheerful atmosphere.
She sent a cheerful holiday message.

vocabulary.meaning: a special day or period when people celebrate or do not work
examples: Many people travel during the holiday season.
Holiday customs differ between cultures.

vocabulary.meaning: a traditional way of behaving in a society or group
examples: Giving gifts is a common custom.
Visitors may enjoy learning about local holiday customs.
